name: Navigation +
description: A standardized, pluggable editing UI built on core Navigation: an Edit Mode, Mode/Tool/Sidebar plugin types, per-user hotkeys and drag-to-upload media, shared by the +Suite page-building modules.

suggests.drupal/edit_plus: The Edit+ tool provides radical inline editing!
suggests.drupal/lb_plus: The Layout Builder+ tools are a drop in replacement for the Layout Builder UI.

project_description:
Navigation+ adds Edit Mode , the photoshop-like toolbar and pluggable UI foundation for the + Suite page builder .

 
 

 
 ▶ Watch an introduction to +Suite 

 The Navigation module replaced Drupal's long standing Toolbar module . Navigation + lets module developers add Modes . Modes allow you to replace the Navigation UI, meaning you can toggle the top bar and side bar into a different mode like Edit Mode (included with this module) or Help Mode .

 Navigation + provides an optional Edit Mode which makes the Edit and Layout Tab obsolete. When you enter Edit Mode a Photoshop like toolbar shows tools that let you edit the page. Edit+ provides inline editing while Layout Builder+ is a drop in replacement for cores Layout Builder UI that adds a features and functionality like sortable sections, nested layouts (a block builder), but most importantly makes Layout Builder work without the layout tab. A true WYSIWYG experience.

 Check out the + Suite recipe for an easy way to install.
